caption: The drawing depicts a single mechanical object placed in the center of a plain, off-white background. The object appears intricate, composed of several parts seemingly made from metal and possibly wood or leather. The primary colors used are brown and gray for the main body of the object, with accents of reddish-brown, amber, and grayish-white. Circular elements are present, including two larger disks adorned with smaller, raised circular studs or rivets around their edges. Several thin, elongated components are colored with a range of brown, yellow, and orange hues, featuring segments and patterns. Curved arms extend from the central mechanism, ending in loops and scroll shapes. The lower right corner contains a handwritten inscription that reads "Rose-Campbell-Corrie." The drawing has precise detailing, with careful shading to indicate texture and material differences among the parts.
title: Spade Bit
